subject: angol
title: Join us for a clean-up day!
situation: Your town is organising a clean-up day in the local park next Saturday. Your English friend, Alex, is staying with a family in your town for a few weeks. Write an e-mail to Alex and invite him to come with you.
situationHu: Jövő szombaton szemétszedő napot tartanak a helyi parkban; hívd meg e-mailben a városodban tartózkodó angol barátodat, Alexet.

points.text: say when and where you will meet
explain what the volunteers will do on the day
tell Alex what to bring or wear

usefulPhrases.en: Would you like to come with me?
We're meeting at the park gate at 9 o'clock.
Let me know if you can come.

checklistExtra: Jövő idejű szerkezeteket (will, be going to, present continuous) használtam a tervekhez?

modelAnswer.text:
Hi Alex,

Our town is organising a clean-up day in Rákóczi Park next Saturday. Would you like to come with me? We're meeting at the main gate of the park at nine o'clock.

The volunteers are going to pick up litter, clean the playground and plant some new trees. It'll be hard work, but there will be free pizza for lunch!

Make sure you wear old clothes and comfortable shoes, and bring a bottle of water. The organisers will give us gloves and bags.

Let me know if you can come!
Gergő

pointsCovered.quote: We're meeting at the main gate of the park at nine o'clock.
The volunteers are going to pick up litter, clean the playground and plant some new trees.
Make sure you wear old clothes and comfortable shoes, and bring a bottle of water.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: valódi meghívás („Would you like to come with me?”), pontos időpont és találkozóhely, három konkrét önkéntes feladat, végül ruha és felszerelés.
Nyelvhelyesség: a jövőre három különböző szerkezet szól, mindegyik a helyén – megbeszélt program: present continuous (We're meeting), terv: going to, jóslat: will.
Szókincs: a témához illő kifejezések (clean-up day, pick up litter, plant trees, volunteers, organisers) változatosak és pontosak.
Hangnem: baráti, lelkes meghívó („It'll be hard work, but …”), a „Let me know if you can come!” zárás választ kér.
Érdemes megtanulni: „Would you like to come with me?”, „We're meeting at … at …”, „Make sure you …”.
